testEnvironment:
Test environment: the snapshot is a git repository whose single commit holds
the reviewed tree — its tree hash was compared against the commit under review
when the snapshot was cut. A suite run here collects and runs what a checkout at
that commit does, so a failing or skipped test is a fact about the tree, not
about this copy of it. Its history is that one synthetic commit: 'git log',
'git diff' and every ancestry question answer about the snapshot and never about
the PR.
The Recipe's Test entrypoint and Check step do not run these merge-gating CI steps, and nothing in this review ran them: rebase-check job (pull_request-only branch-currency assertion, not meaningful in a worktree of origin/main); proc-macos job (node --test tests/proc.test.mjs on macOS) (subsumed by the full suite on this macOS host); smoke-omp job (needs pinned omp installed via bun, absent here); install-and-smoke job (needs pinned omp installed via bun and network, absent here).

unverified.claim: pull.md's 'Record the dispatch before you make it' paragraph (lines 416-418) still names the member as the literal `impl-<N>`: `render implementer --member impl-<N>`, `ledger.mjs dispatch <N> impl-<N>` and 'marks `impl-<N>` live'. That is the same fixed-name wording this PR removes from member-lifecycle.md and implementer.md, so the docs sweep is incomplete in one place.
unverified.evidence: I grepped the snapshot (excluding tests/fixtures/**) for 'dispatch <N> impl-<N>|--member impl-<N>|…'. It hits pull.md:416-417 and tests/render-before-dispatch-prose.test.mjs:21, which pins that exact phrase. pull.md:703-704, read in the same snapshot, says 'The row, the render's `--member`, `ledger.mjs dispatch`, the `DISPATCH` line's `name` … all carry that name' (the retry name). The ticket's Out of scope section excludes pull.md, and docs/metrics/reviews/4424/run-M717PSUr/review.json:130 shows that review refuted this same claim. So it does not block this PR. I did not run a mutation on it.
unverified.suggested_fix: Optionally file a follow-up to reword pull.md:416-418 to `<member>` (the name the Pull printed) and update the pin at tests/render-before-dispatch-prose.test.mjs:21 to match. Nothing is needed in this PR.
